settings.label: Do points expire?
settings.text: Points last 12 months from your latest qualifying order, so every new purchase extends them.

settings.label: How do I reach the top level?
settings.text: Spend $400 within 12 months while signed in to your account.

settings.label: Do store purchases count?
settings.text: No. Only orders placed on this site earn points.

settings.label: What happens if I return something?
settings.text: The points earned from that item are removed from your balance.

settings.label: Where can I see my balance?
settings.text: In the rewards tab of your account and in your cart before checkout.

settings.label: I am a stylist. Can I join?
settings.text: Professionals have a separate program through our pro site.
